unwired.tooling/verify-bonsai-interop.mjs: Maintainer-only real-browser Bonsai/Micropolis interop audit; it drives two games and Playwright on a merged build and is run by hand, not by a release or CI runner.
unwired.tooling/verify-bonsai-remaster-assets.mj: Maintainer-only Bonsai remaster asset audit; it inspects generated art inputs and is run on demand, outside the release runner.
unwired.tooling/verify-control-census.mjs: Maintainer control-panel census ratchet run on demand via npm run verify:control-census; it needs a full browser sweep and is deliberately outside the release gate set.
unwired.tooling/verify-doc-claims.mjs: Maintainer-only claim audit of the agent knowledge layer; it is a report, deliberately not a gate, run by hand after editing the documents it checks.
unwired.tooling/verify-hig.mjs: Maintainer Human Interface Guidelines sweep run on demand via npm run verify:hig; it is a design audit surface, not a condition of the release pipeline.
unwired.tooling/verify-liquid-render.mjs: Maintainer-only visual comparison for Liquid Glass rendering; it captures local frames by hand and is not wired into any shipping runner.
unwired.tooling/verify-mcp-guest.mjs: Maintainer browser acceptance for the MCP guest bridge; it spins a guest server and Playwright and is run by the MCP lane on demand, not by release gates.
unwired.tooling/verify-micropolis-acceptance.mjs: Maintainer-only Micropolis acceptance gate (npm run verify:micropolis-acceptance); it needs a local server and Playwright and stays out of the public source contract.
unwired.tooling/verify-native-action-audit.mjs: Audit for the frozen native Swift rewrite, run on demand via npm run verify:native-action-audit; the native port is not built or gated by this release.
unwired.tooling/verify-native-parity-ledger.mjs: Ledger audit for the frozen native Swift rewrite, run on demand via npm run verify:native-parity-ledger; kept as history while the native port stays frozen.
unwired.tooling/verify-one-more-tune-bank.mjs: Maintainer bank check for One More Tune, run by hand as the design asks ("提交前运行数据校验"); the same function it calls, validateBank, is asserted by the one-more-tune feature contract, so a release gate does not need to run the command a second time.
unwired.tooling/verify-theme-lab-fidelity.mjs: Maintainer theme-lab fidelity capture (npm run verify:theme-lab:fidelity); it compares local screenshot boards by hand and is not part of verify:release.
unwired.tooling/verify-web-vitals.mjs: Performance budget probe for the phone and laptop start-up path, run on demand; a wall clock on a shared machine is not repeatable enough to refuse a release, so it reports numbers rather than gating them.
unwired.tooling/visual-snapshot.mjs: Superseded local visual-snapshot utility kept for maintainer inspection; the appearance snapshot and token tables own pixel coverage now.
